entities.name: Octo Canvas
entities.description: A conversational AI agent and vibe design platform that builds brand-native generative destinations from brief to live deployment, with no code or post-launch maintenance required from the brand.

entities.name: OctoGPT
entities.description: A sibling Octo product that runs as a configuration on the same shared agent foundation as Octo Canvas and references the same persistent brand profile in BCC.

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: The standardised component SDK (video, chat, text, images, configurable via JSON) into which Octo Canvas auto-deploys its generated destinations, providing guardrails versus freeform code.

entities.name: Generative Destination
entities.description: A brand-native, AI-built destination produced by Octo Canvas that draws on brand capabilities at runtime and is hosted and maintained on Genuin infrastructure.

entities.name: Brand Knowledge
entities.description: The source-of-truth layer for a brand's identity, persona and tonality, drawn from BCC knowledge, communities, social accounts and uploaded files.

entities.name: Brand Capabilities
entities.description: A brand's connected functional surfaces — CMS connections, podcast feeds, contest APIs, event data — isolated per brand and used by Octo Canvas at design and runtime.

entities.name: Capabilities Marketplace
entities.description: A library of 9,900+ pre-built capabilities that brands can connect to instead of generating new ones from brand knowledge.

entities.name: BCC
entities.description: The persistent brand identity and knowledge store where a brand's profile is stored once and referenced by all Octo products including OctoGPT and Octo Canvas.

entities.name: Agent Orchestration
entities.description: The component that routes generative destination intent to Octo Canvas and manages agent-to-agent coordination across the Octo product suite.

entities.name: Growth Intelligence
entities.description: The personalisation engine, community infrastructure and workflow orchestration layer that knows how to grow and engage a brand's audience.

entities.name: UX Capabilities
entities.description: The set of SDK components (video, chat, text, images) configurable via JSON that render every visual element of a generative destination.

entities.name: Shared Infrastructure
entities.description: The common agent foundation underlying all Octo products; both OctoGPT and Octo Canvas are configurations on this shared layer.

entities.name: Genuin Buildtime Infrastructure
entities.description: The build-time stack that powers Octo Canvas using a brand's Octo Capabilities and Brand Knowledge, recommending and auto-generating capabilities to design a brand-resonant vibe.

entities.name: Genuin Runtime Infrastructure
entities.description: The runtime stack implemented via Genuin SDKs that integrates directly with client CMS systems so destination content is live, fresh and personalised rather than a static snapshot.

entities.name: Relume
entities.description: A competing site-building tool that Octo Canvas is positioned against; uses blank-canvas or generic-template starting points with partner-managed deployment.

entities.name: Google Stitch
entities.description: A Google design tool positioned alongside Relume as a competitor with free-form output and partner-managed deployment, contrasted with Octo Canvas's brand-first, Genuin-managed approach.

entities.name: Marketers
entities.description: The primary user audience that Octo Canvas guides through its two-phase Design and Build process to create generative brand destinations.
